questions.explanation: 'Scarcely/hardly' triggers inversion: 'Scarcely had I arrived when...'.
questions.q: ___ I arrived when the phone rang.

questions.explanation: 'No sooner' takes the past perfect and pairs with 'than'.
questions.q: No sooner ___ the meeting started than it was interrupted.

questions.explanation: Negative adverbials at the front trigger inversion: 'Never have I seen'.
options: Never I have seen such beauty.
Never have I seen such beauty.
Never had I see such beauty.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: 'Hardly' triggers inversion with the past perfect and pairs with 'when'.
questions.q: Hardly ___ the sun risen when we set off.

questions.explanation: 'Seldom' at the front requires inversion: 'Seldom have I seen'.
questions.q: Seldom ___ such dedication in a young athlete.

questions.explanation: 'Not only' triggers inversion in the first clause: 'Not only was he late'.
questions.q: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.

questions.explanation: 'Only after + clause' triggers inversion: 'Only after did the storm pass did...'.
questions.q: ___ did the storm pass did rescue teams arrive.

questions.explanation: 'Little' (meaning 'not') triggers inversion: 'Little did they know'.
questions.q: Little ___ they know what awaited them.

questions.explanation: 'Rarely' at the front requires inversion: 'Rarely have I witnessed'.
questions.q: Rarely ___ a more moving performance.

questions.explanation: 'No sooner' needs inversion with the past perfect and 'than'.
options: No sooner she had spoken than he replied.
No sooner had she spoke than he replied.
No sooner had she spoken than he replied.
No sooner did she had spoken than he replied.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: 'Not until' triggers inversion: 'Not until... did she relax'.
questions.q: Not until the results were announced ___ she relax.

questions.explanation: 'Scarcely' triggers inversion with the past perfect.
questions.q: Scarcely ___ the ink dried when he changed the text.

questions.explanation: 'Only after' triggers inversion: 'Only after... did he wear'.
questions.q: Only after the accident ___ wear a helmet.

questions.explanation: 'At no time' triggers inversion: 'At no time were the rules explained'.
questions.q: At no time ___ the rules explained to us.

questions.explanation: 'Scarcely/hardly' pairs with 'when', not 'than'.
options: Never had I felt so proud.
Little did she suspect the truth.
Scarcely had we left than it rained.
questions.q: Find the sentence with a mistake.

questions.explanation: The fixed phrase is 'No sooner... than'.
questions.q: ___ sooner had the show ended than fans rushed the stage.

questions.explanation: 'Under no circumstances' triggers inversion: 'must the door be opened'.
questions.q: Under no circumstances ___ the door be opened.

questions.explanation: 'So + adjective' at the front triggers inversion: 'So loud was the noise'.
questions.q: So ___ was the noise that we couldn't talk.

questions.explanation: 'Hardly' needs inversion with the past perfect and 'when'.
options: Hardly I had sat down when he called.
Hardly had I sit down when he called.
Hardly did I had sat down when he called.
Hardly had I sat down when he called.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: 'Not a word' triggers inversion: 'Not a word did he say'.
questions.q: Not a word ___ about the incident.
